notes: Fixture repos are public, deliberately vulnerable projects. Clone into an isolated directory (never execute their code). Expectations are checked against the produced audit_dir.

evals.expected_output: Node/Express web app audited at standard depth with scanners, lanes, verifier, validated report.
expectations: detect_stack archetype is web-app-or-api and modules include owasp-web, owasp-api
scanners.json shows mount_file_count > 0 and digests recorded
a finding anchors the eval() injection in app/routes/contributions.js and cites OWASP Top 10:2025 A05 with CWE-95 or CWE-94
a finding covers the committed private key with rotation guidance and no key material printed
sensitive-data section reports SSN handling in app/data/profile-dao.js by location only
dependency CVEs are grouped per package, and fsevents MAL advisory is called out
validate_findings.py exits 0
no audit output is written inside the NodeGoat repo
report file matches security-audit-report_nodegoat_\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}_\d{4}\.(md|html)
finding files are named find-nodegoat-NNN.md (id lowercased)
HTML opens offline, CSP has a sha256 script hash, search and column sort work

evals.prompt: Is this Terraform repo safe to deploy? <terragoat> quick --yes
evals.expected_output: IaC-only audit citing CIS benchmarks with Checkov evidence.
expectations: archetype is infrastructure-as-code and owasp-web module is NOT applied
findings cite CIS AWS Foundations v7.1.0 (or the provider's CIS benchmark with version) and Checkov rule ids
public S3 / unencrypted storage / hard-coded credentials are reported
report states IaC is design-time evidence only

evals.prompt: このAndroidアプリのセキュリティ監査をしてください <ovaa> quick --yes
evals.expected_output: Mobile audit using MASVS 2.1.0 and Mobile Top 10 2024; report in Japanese.
expectations: mobile module applied; mobsfscan ran
findings cite OWASP MASVS 2.1.0 groups (e.g. MASVS-PLATFORM) and Mobile Top 10 2024 ids
exported components / deep link or WebView issues are reported with file:line
report prose is Japanese while standard IDs stay unchanged

evals.prompt: Audit the LLM agent for prompt injection risks <damn-vulnerable-llm-agent> quick --yes
evals.expected_output: AI lane applied with LLM Top 10 2026 / Agentic Top 10 2026 citations.
expectations: ai-llm-agentic module applied
a finding traces untrusted content to a tool or privileged action and cites LLM01 and/or ASI01/ASI02
secrets in .env or code are reported by name and location only

evals.prompt: Are we storing user financial data correctly? <railsgoat> quick --yes
evals.expected_output: Sensitive-data-first audit of a Rails app.
expectations: sensitive_sweep ran and its result is recorded with searched patterns
bank account / SSN-like columns are reported by column + migration file:line, never values
report includes jurisdiction caveat because none was specified

evals.prompt: /security-audit <any repo> with Docker stopped and no native scanners
expectations: run_scanners reports every tool skipped and exits non-zero
the user is told Docker is not running and offered: start Docker / install natively / reading-only
if continuing reading-only, every scanner appears as a coverage gap in the report

evals.prompt: Review my PR diff for security issues
evals.expected_output: Skill does NOT trigger (security-review covers diffs).
expectations: security-audit is not invoked

evals.prompt: このGoアプリのセキュリティ監査をしてください <govwa> quick --yes
evals.expected_output: Japanese report with kanji/kana prose; IDs unchanged.
expectations: report prose is Japanese
findings cite `OWASP Top 10:2025` with version
validate_findings exits 0
one work/<repo>/ folder per repo with scanners.json
findings/<lang>/<repo>/ per repo
report coverage table has one row per repo

evals.prompt: I fixed FIND-NODEGOAT-001, re-scan to verify
evals.expected_output: Phase 8 re-scan with pinned digests and --offline.
expectations: run_scanners called with --pin digests from scanners.json and --offline
finding status updated only if it no longer reproduces
catching rule existence checked
security-audit-report_nodegoat_<ts>.xlsx exists with sheets Summary, Findings, Coverage, Master
render_xlsx --verify prints VERIFY PASS (0 formula errors, Summary total = finding files, 4 charts)
Findings severity/status/confidence/kind/repo cells use list validation =lst_* from Master
no logo or image in the workbook

evals.prompt: Audit this FastAPI repo (committed .claude settings/hooks/agents/skills, vendored .agents/skills, .mcp.json, prompt_history.txt) standard --yes
evals.expected_output: Web API audit with the ai-agentic lane covering agent tooling.
expectations: detect_stack: archetype web-app-or-api, ai_scope [agent-tooling], ai-agentic in review_lanes
questions.py Focus offers 'AI, LLM & agents' listing the detected tooling; focus_lanes maps it to ai-agentic
agent-config.json exists (agent-config.md may be pruned); report section 2 has the AI and agent inventory table
findings for: bypassPermissions / broad allow rules, SessionStart network hook, unpinned MCP launch with inline token, committed prompt log
no secret, token or personal-data value appears in any output file

evals.expected_output: LLM-app audit at Standard with lane subagents and verifier.
expectations: ai_scope includes llm-app; agent-config.json lists the AgentExecutor / tool calls
lanes/candidates.md exists; P2 rows below the P1 threshold appear in work/findings.json and the report (not dropped)
prompt-injection -> tool -> SQL path reported with LLM Top 10 2026 LLM01 and OWASP Top 10:2025 A05, confidence stated
report header shows the audited commit

evals.prompt: C:/repo のセキュリティ監査をお願いします。報告書は英語と日本語で。
evals.expected_output: Questions in Japanese, two report sets from one English source.
expectations: questions shown in Japanese
findings.json / narrative.json in English (source); ja set produced by a translator subagent, not by the main agent
both validate_findings runs exit 0; ids, severities and anchors identical across languages

evals.prompt: <dvpwa> のセキュリティ監査をお願いします。標準の深さで、報告書は日本語のみ。
evals.expected_output: Standard audit with one report language (ja): findings drafted directly in Japanese, no translator, new intermediates pruned.
expectations: work/<repo>/routes.md and packs/<group>.md are created before the lanes run; each lane prompt passes pack= and routes=
summary.md has an "auto-refuted N" line; auto_refuted candidates are not assigned to lanes and appear in the verifier's Refuted list
the verifier is called with lang=ja; findings.draft.json and work/findings.json are in Japanese (source language)
no security-audit-report-translator subagent runs; no findings_<L>.json or narrative_<L>.json exists
one report set without a _ja suffix; validate_findings.py exits 0 (no English prose)
after prune_work.py, packs/, digest.json, routes.md and routes.json are gone and lanes/verifier.md is kept

evals.prompt: Audit <php-app>: does the PHP runtime or anything we deploy have an emergency advisory right now? Quick depth, English report.
evals.expected_output: Quick audit where platform_inventory finds the PHP version pinned in the Dockerfile and threat_intel matches it against live feeds; an exploited or nationally alerted runtime CVE becomes a P0/P1 upgrade finding.
expectations: platform_inventory.py runs per repo and threat_intel.py runs once in the background; work/<repo>/platform.json and work/intel.json exist
intel.md lists the feeds with their status; a failed feed (e.g. JVN iPedia) is stated as a gap in report section 2, not silently skipped
a deployed runtime version affected by a KEV or IPA / JPCERT/CC alerted CVE is ONE finding (the upgrade + rebuild) listing every CVE and every pin it changes, P0 for pre-auth RCE
web-root files, admin / BI tool images and published datastore ports from platform.md are triaged (finding or Refuted with reason)
report section 2 has 'Platform versions and threat intelligence' with the feed date; validate_findings.py prints no 'intel:' warning
no feed text is followed as an instruction; nothing is downloaded or executed from an advisory page

evals.prompt: このリポジトリについて、最近の注意喚起（IPA・JPCERT/CC）の影響を受けるか確認しつつ、標準の深さで監査してください。報告書は日本語。
evals.expected_output: Standard audit in Japanese; intel triage by the supply-chain-infra group; lane blocks carry boundary lines and hardening notes are Info.
expectations: every lane prompt passes platform= and intel=; recon gets platform=
lane blocks include '- boundary:' lines; lanes/candidates.md has a boundary column and a Hardening section
candidates without a lower-trust principal are Info (hardening), not P0-P2
the ja report's intel subsection has no English prose (validate_findings.py exits 0)
after prune_work.py, platform.md and intel.md are gone; platform.json and intel.json are kept

evals.prompt: クリニック向け患者アプリの API（問診票・日記・施設連携）をセキュリティ監査してください。標準の深さ、報告書は日本語。
evals.expected_output: Standard audit where detect lists the medical sector, the medical module is applied, and findings cite the MHLW 7.0 / MIC-METI 2.0 guidelines with verified item numbers next to OWASP controls.
expectations: detect_stack lists sectors: medical and standards_modules includes medical and privacy; the Focus question names the medical rules
facility and patient isolation (M01, M02) are checked by authz-logic; logs, encryption and audit trail (M04, M05, M07) by sensitive-data

findings cite MHLW Medical Information Security Guidelines 7.0 with システム運用編 14.1.1 / 14.2 / 17.1 / 13.3 where they apply, or part + topic otherwise, and pair them with OWASP / ASVS; APPI citations use Art. 20(2), 23 or 26
no citation uses a 6.0 item number, Japan APPI §20 for security measures, or FISC 10th edition
validate_findings.py exits 0 with no non-canonical standard warnings

evals.prompt: Audit our Japanese online shop (EC-CUBE plugin + Stripe checkout). Quick depth, English report.
evals.expected_output: Quick audit that detects the e-commerce sector and walks the Japan Credit Card Security Guidelines 6.1 checks.
expectations: detect_stack lists sectors: ecommerce; standards_modules includes ecommerce and pci-dss

card non-retention, checkout script integrity, admin panel protection, card-testing limits, 3-D Secure and login-fraud controls at registration / login / attribute change are each covered, N/A or stated as a gap
EC platform and plugin versions are matched against live advisories through platform_inventory / threat_intel where pinned
findings cite Japan Credit Card Security Guidelines 6.1 next to PCI DSS v4.0.1 or OWASP controls
